name: Wait for Sirra to Finish
summary: This brief pause marks the moment Sirra Von'Indi deciphers the cryptic note delivered from the reclusive hermit Abercrombie. As she puts quill to paper in Darkshire's Town Hall, an ominous dread settles over the room, hinting that the hermit's words are far darker than expected.

sections.title: A Moment of Translation
sections.body: After receiving the mysterious note penned by the hermit Abercrombie, Sirra Von'Indi requires only a short spell to decipher its text. As a resident scholar aiding the Night Watch and town leadership, she undertakes the task without realizing immediately what horrors the message conceals.

sections.title: An Ominous Chill
sections.body: The moment Sirra completes the transcription, the atmosphere shifts palpably. A sudden heaviness hangs over the room, likened to a thick black curtain dropping over the region. The deciphered note portends great danger for Darkshire, revealing that Abercrombie's seemingly harmless errands were part of a sinister, vengeful design.

faq.answer: Sirra Von'Indi is an educated scholar residing in Darkshire's Town Hall. She assists Mayor Ello Ebonlocke and the local authorities by translating ancient scripts, strange documents, and ciphered messages brought in from the gloomy wilds of Duskwood.

The note was penned by Abercrombie, the hermit who lives secluded in a shack near the western edge of Duskwood. You carried out a string of errands for him before this note ended up in Sirra's hands for translation.

faq.q: Why does the air feel heavy when she finishes?
faq.answer: The sudden oppressive chill is an omen of impending doom: whatever the note says, it is grim news for Darkshire, and its full meaning becomes clear once the translation reaches Lord Ello Ebonlocke.

faq.q: Who should receive the translated letter next?
aliases: where do i take the translation
faq.answer: Once Sirra finishes the translation, she instructs you to carry the chilling words directly across the room to Mayor Ello Ebonlocke so the Night Watch can prepare for what is to come.

faq.q: Is Abercrombie actually an enemy of Darkshire?
faq.answer: Abercrombie presents himself as a harmless, reclusive old man needing assistance to survive. The heavy dread that falls as Sirra finishes her translation suggests his note holds grim news for Darkshire, and its full meaning becomes clear once it reaches Lord Ello Ebonlocke.

faq.q: Why do you have to wait for her?
faq.answer: Translating ancient ciphers takes time and focus. The brief delay gives Sirra a moment to parse the hermit's handwriting and coded phrasing before producing the readable transcript for the mayor.

angles.text: Darkshire's fragile safety hangs by a thread.
Mages studying arcane scripts and runes will recognize the dark, lingering resonance of a cursed message as its contents are laid bare.
